data: FirstRate original CSV, 2022-09-30 through 2023-09-29; paired complete regular sessions only
data_status: Previously researched. Chronological replication, NOT an untouched final holdout.
walk_forward: Fixed parameters; expanding prior history, monthly OOS blocks in validation and test. No parameter fitting to a later block.
selection: Predeclared default parameters. No strategy or parameter is selected by final-test P&L. Validation veto and one-at-a-time development/validation sensitivity only.
directions: Long only. Short orders unsupported and rejected.
execution: Completed 5-minute signal; next minute-open opportunity; synthetic bid/ask, conservative stop-first ordering; no fill at favorable intrabar extremes; reference entry-band/friction sizing reused
sensitivity: One parameter at a time: target R 1.5/2.5 and holding time 20/40 minutes; strategy-specific thresholds 0.8/1.2 times default. Validation/development only; no final-test selection.

gates.sample_floor_note: 20 active day clusters is a minimum for reporting a resampled interval, not a universal adequate trade count or proof of edge. Precision and independent period evidence still required.

arbitration: Per symbol. Explicit eligibility and predeclared equal priority. Contradiction or equal-priority ambiguity: no trade. Cross-symbol processing in sorted symbol order with atomic shared risk reservations; no recent-P&L allocation.
live_activation: Reused historical data cannot establish LIVE_ELIGIBLE. Acceptance gates must not be relaxed after results; live enablement requires independent evidence and explicit operator approval.
